name: Button
description: Primary interactive control. Dark-first, uses semantic design tokens only. Matches the Figma Button component set (Buttons page, node 1005:681): LG 48px / radius 12 / 16px Semibold / 24px icons; SM 32px / radius 8 / 14px Semibold / 16px icons; gap 12.

variant.description: Visual style. Matches Figma variant names ('destructive' = Figma 'Primary Destructive'). NOTE: outline deliberately deviates from Figma — stroke stays constant on hover/pressed (approved 2026-07); feedback comes from the flat fill tokens.

size.description: lg = 48px height, sm = 32px height. Matches Figma sizes exactly.

iconLeft.description: OPTIONAL, independent of iconRight. Icon before the label. Use <Icon name="..."/> without a size prop — Button sizes it (24px LG / 16px SM) and it inherits the variant's text color automatically.

iconRight.description: OPTIONAL, independent of iconLeft. Icon after the label. Same sizing/color behavior as iconLeft.

children.description: Label. Omit with an icon prop for an icon-only button; then aria-label is REQUIRED.

tokensConsumed: --br-space-sm (gap, padding, radius LG — Figma binds Scale/300)

iconUsage.combinations: All four are valid: no icons (default), iconLeft only, iconRight only, both. Icons are decorative reinforcement — the label carries the meaning.
when: DEFAULT: no icons. Add one only when it clarifies the action.
iconLeft = WHAT the action is about: settings, plus (create), check (confirm), x (cancel), arrow-left (back).
iconRight = WHERE the action leads: arrow-right (proceed/CTA), chevron-right (drill in/next).
Use BOTH only in wizard/navigation contexts (e.g. settings + chevron-right).
Icon-only (omit children, keep one icon): compact toolbars and repeated row actions — aria-label is REQUIRED.
Pick names from src/components/Icon/component.json vocabulary; any icon works in any variant (currentColor).

rules: Requires src/tokens/dist/tokens.css to be loaded app-wide.
Never override colors with raw values; extend via semantic tokens.
Text on the teal primary button is DARK, not white.
Theme is inherited from the nearest [data-theme] ancestor — never set per-button.
